subject: science
passage: The platypus departs from the usual pattern of mammalian life in several ways. Females lay leathery eggs rather than giving birth to live young, and after the eggs hatch, they feed their young on milk that seeps from patches of skin on the belly, since they have no nipples. ______ adult males are among the very few venomous mammals: each carries a sharp spur on the ankle of each hind leg that can deliver venom strong enough to disable a small animal and to cause intense, lasting pain in humans.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The first sentence says the platypus is unusual "in several ways." The second sentence gives the first set of ways (egg laying and milk without nipples). The last sentence adds a further, separate way: males are venomous. The transition must add another point in support of the same claim.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Specifically" would introduce a more detailed account of the previous sentence, but venom has nothing to do with eggs or milk. It is a separate example of how the platypus is unusual. This is the closest near miss.
explanation.B: Correct. "Moreover" adds venom as one more way in which the platypus differs from most mammals.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Nevertheless" signals a contrast, but being venomous is another unusual trait, which supports the first sentence.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Males are not venomous because females lay eggs; the two traits are independent.
